# Waymark 0.2.9

Pet farming markers now use actual reference monster spawn positions in Verteron and Altgard, replacing region-center placement wherever coordinates are available. Select a pet to see individual spawn dots; enabled pets also show nearby dots on the minimap.

- 415 exact NPC/map matches, 11,621 source positions, 152 pets with spawn references.
- Farming routes use distinct spawn anchors, with clearly labeled regional fallbacks.
- Existing saved routes, pet levels and character progress are preserved.

Spawn references are static map data; live availability, altitude and Global patch differences are not verified. Abyss pet spawns remain pending layer verification.

Also includes identity-bound passive soul-gain and explicit pet-level messages, with separate tracked-session gains rather than inferred level thresholds. Requires fresh self identity after restarting mid-session; live Global event validation remains pending. Position recognition now shares terrain features and bounds cold arrow searches so accurate matches can arrive within the existing freshness window.
